mechanisms.name: Chart changes that need a sync plan (not functional breaks): RBAC restructure, webhook probe port, webhook availability during rollout, additive CRD changes
mechanisms.mechanism: RBAC: `cert-manager-controller-challenges` is deleted and replaced by dns01 and http01 challenges roles. The `orders` ClusterRole gains secrets and events rules. Webhook probes change from `port: 6080` to named port `healthcheck`. Webhook availability: with a single webhook replica and `failurePolicy: Fail` on both webhook configurations, any Certificate create or update is rejected while the webhook pod restarts, so a payments sync in that window can fail transiently. Argo waves help with ordering but do not wait on webhook readiness after a later resync. CRD changes are additive: new `signatureAlgorithm`, `profile` and Vault `serverName` fields, new short names `iss` and `ciss`, and doc text changes.
mechanisms.mitigationOrNoExposure: Argo has `prune: true`, so old RBAC objects go and new ones are created in the same sync. There are no ACME issuers or Challenge resources (only `selfSigned` and `ca` issuers), so the challenge controller is idle, and the orders rule additions are harmless. The rendered `to.yaml` defines `containerPort: 6080, name: healthcheck`, so the probe resolves. Argo `selfHeal` retries and sync waves help ordering. `crds.keep: true` and `ServerSideApply=true` make CRD updates safe. No existing field the repo uses is removed, renamed or altered, other than the rotationPolicy default. The verdict calls the chart-level changes low risk.
citedEvidence: Argo `prune: true`, `selfHeal`, sync waves (cert-manager 0, pki 1, payments 2)
missingEvidence: Whether the `iss` / `ciss` short names collide with other CRDs
recommendedValidation: Check `iss` / `ciss` short names for collisions with other CRDs (`kubectl api-resources`)
Sync plan: bump `targetRevision` in `clusters/prod/cert-manager.yaml` and watch the single-replica webhook rollout
Pause `payments` auto-sync during the cert-manager rollout, or retry on webhook errors
Confirm Argo prunes the old challenges ClusterRole and binding cleanly
